body: Found by CEM dynamic lane V1-0592 (PR beamfall/corvint#1003, head 1398a8c24, base origin/main 7c9a52d90, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/dynamic-2026-10-17/. The profile admits no Jest config and no timeout option; the timeout+cleanup case ended via Jest's native 15s timeout, not the executor timeout, and retry (R) has no native flag. Expected: the executor timeout path is reachable and witnessed, or the case recorded as not applicable with reason.
title: storybook-test-runner profile admits no timeout or config, so the executor timeout case is unreachable
